purpose: Teach: アルク/ホース/ボディー/マリン/キッド/チャーリー/アドバンス/ブランチ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアルクの英語教材を一緒にやって下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to do that English learning program with you.
lines.style: Warm announcement, slight lift at the end like sharing good news. Gentle, matter-of-fact. The tone of a mother offering something she knows will matter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと庭のホースで水撒きしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watered the garden with the hose today.
lines.style: Bright, direct delivery. Quick pace — eager to share the memory. Small voice, genuine pride in the experience, not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが車のボディーを月一でワックスがけされるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad waxes the car once a month, you know.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly musing. Quiet recognition — noticing the small, steady things fathers do. Soft trailing tone, like thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマリンランドのイルカショー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to see the dolphin show at Marine Land.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but contained — not shouting, just genuine warmth. Clear, direct words. The delight of being included in something special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キッド」のDVDを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave you that Kid DVD.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Unhurried pacing. The tone of noticing — how the small gifts your father gives you accumulate into care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとチャーリー・ブラウンのコミック読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read Charlie Brown comics with Dad.
lines.style: Simple, contented. Steady rhythm. The voice of a child naming moments that feel ordinary but held something good. No urgency, just warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲームのアドバンス機を整理されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad organized the old Game Boy Advance games.
lines.style: Quiet noticing, like cataloging the tender details of someone's care. Measured. A mother recognizing how fathers show up in small, practical ways.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと家族のブランチを楽しんだよ
lines.en: Mom, we had family brunch together with Dad.
lines.style: Satisfied, settled delivery. Warm completion — the contentment of a full moment. Slight breath-ease at the end, like resting after something good.
